info.title: Signups & Identity API
info.description: Mode C API of Signups & Identity (SSPS v1): passwordless sign-in (one-time codes, magic links), customer profiles, sessions issued by the website’s own identity issuer (EdDSA JWTs verified offline by any product; JWKS per website), account pages, risk checks, consent and data rights. All data lives in the merchant’s own database; messages go only through the merchant’s own messaging connector. Times are ISO-8601 UTC; phone numbers are E.164. Errors are RFC 9457 problems (`type` ends with a stable code). POSTs that send a message or create a record accept an optional `Idempotency-Key`: a repeated key within 24 h is refused with 409 duplicate_request; token-issuing POSTs are single-use by construction. Browser keys (pk_) identify the customer with the access token in `SS-Identity`.

get.summary: Customers, newest first (cursor pagination), optionally by exact e-mail or phone (any typed form). sk_ only.

post.summary: Create (import) a customer from your server. Identifiers are optional and unique per website; `verified` marks identifiers you already verified. The answer carries no personal data: GET /v1/customers/{id} for the record. sk_ only.

patch.summary: Update profile fields (JSON Merge Patch), addresses (replaces the list), custom fields, `status` (active | blocked — blocking ends every session) and `externalId`. sk_ only.

delete.summary: Delete a customer now: sessions ended, personal data anonymised (the id remains). sk_ only.

get.summary: The signed-in customer's profile (SS-Identity), or ?customerId= with an sk_ key.

patch.summary: Update the signed-in profile against the field schema (profile.fields). E-mail and phone change only through a verified OTP / link with purpose "link".

post.summary: Send a one-time code through the merchant’s messaging connector. The answer is identical whether or not the identifier has an account. Limits: resend cooldown (429 too_soon), per identifier / IP / website per hour (429 send_limit), velocity (429 velocity_limit); Retry-After is set. purpose "link" adds the identifier to the signed-in customer (SS-Identity).

202.description: Accepted (sent unless the identifier cannot sign in)

post.summary: Verify a code: on success the customer is created if new and signed in (access + refresh tokens). Failures: code_invalid (the `attemptsRemaining` extension member, also errors[0] attempts_remaining), code_expired, attempts_exhausted, consent_required (errors list the documents; send the same code again with consents). Single-use by construction: no Idempotency-Key.
E-mail a single-use sign-in link back to the website’s own domain (https, allowed paths; the token is in the #ss_magic fragment). Same uniform answer and limits as codes.
Exchange the link token (from the URL fragment) for a session. link_invalid / link_expired / consent_required. Single-use by construction.

get.summary: Active sessions (devices) of the signed-in customer (SS-Identity) or of ?customerId= (sk_).

delete.summary: End one session of the customer.

post.summary: Rotate the refresh token and get a new access token. Replaying an already-rotated token ends the session (refresh_reused) unless it is within the concurrent-refresh grace (refresh_conflict). Single-use by construction.
End every session of the customer and bump the session version (access tokens stop working here at once; other products refuse them when they expire).

get.summary: The website’s identity issuer: issuer, JWKS URL, audience, claim map, published keys, whether the Portal already carries it, and the exact Portal call that registers it (Website → Identity). sk_ only.

post.summary: Ask the Portal to make Signups this website’s identity issuer (the body of GET /v1/issuer `portal.body`, sent with the product’s own credentials). The Portal keeps the request pending until the merchant approves it (Website → Identity); once approved the same call answers active, so it is safe to repeat. Signups also sends it once by itself on entitlement.changed@1 while the issuer is not registered. sk_ only.
Start a signing-key rotation now: the new key is published first and signs after sessions.key_prepublish_hours. sk_ only.

get.summary: Public keys of the website’s issuer (`<websiteId>.json`; Ed25519, alg EdDSA; pre-published and retiring keys included). Public, cacheable.
Discovery document of the website’s issuer (signing metadata). Public, cacheable.
Everything the account pages show for the signed-in customer (SS-Identity): profile, devices, orders, agreements, data requests — the sections the website enabled.
Blocked attempts, velocity limits, refresh-token reuse and new-device sign-ins, newest first. sk_ only.
Documents with the customer’s acceptance and the acceptance history (SS-Identity, or ?customerId= with sk_).

post.summary: Accept documents at their current versions.

get.summary: The customer’s export and deletion requests.

post.summary: export: completed at once; the data is downloaded with GET `download` within data_rights.export_link_minutes (the POST answer never carries the data). delete: scheduled after data_rights.cooling_off_days (cancellable; 0 = now). 409 data_request_pending when a deletion is already scheduled.

get.summary: The data of a completed export request (customer, devices, agreements, orders, requests) while its download window is open (410 gone afterwards).

post.summary: Dashboard "Run due deletions": execute the deletion requests whose cooling-off ended (at most 100 per call). A due customer is also deleted whenever it is read; nothing runs on a timer.

get.summary: What this website has enabled (from the signed document).

post.summary: Element / domain events the site pushes to this product.

websiteKey.description: pk_ (browser, domain-locked; customer data only with an SS-Identity access token) or sk_ (server) website key

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Optional. On routes that create records, a key already used for the same route within 24 h answers 409 duplicate_request.

Identity.name: SS-Identity
Identity.description: the customer’s access token issued by this product

attemptsRemaining.description: RFC 9457 extension member (code_invalid): verification attempts left for this code.

retryAfterSeconds.description: RFC 9457 extension member (429 too_soon / send_limit / velocity_limit): seconds until a retry can succeed; mirrors Retry-After.

to.description: E-mail address, or a phone number in international form (or national with otp.default_calling_code)

accessToken.description: EdDSA JWT: iss, sub (customer id), aud, iat, exp, jti, sid, sv, amr, email?, email_verified?, phone_number?, phone_number_verified?

registered.description: Whether the signed entitlement document already carries this issuer.

request.description: The last request Signups sent to the Portal to become this website’s identity issuer (POST /v1/issuer:register, the dashboard or on entitlement.changed@1), while it matches the current issuer; null otherwise.

download.description: export requests: where to GET the data

status.description: pending: waiting for the merchant’s approval in the Portal; active: the Portal already has this issuer.
